title: ACG Kigerfly and Kiger Hike Bring Lightweight Performance to the Trail
summary: All Conditions Gear is inviting outdoor athletes to experience lightweight trail movement with two new shoes designed to help them connect more closely with the terrain: Kigerfly, the brand’s lightest trail-racing shoe ever, and Kiger Hike, a lightweight hiking shoe made for rugged exploration.
body_markdown:
All Conditions Gear (ACG) is inviting outdoor athletes to experience lightweight trail movement with two new shoes designed to help them connect more closely with the terrain: Kigerfly, the brand’s lightest trail-racing shoe ever, and Kiger Hike, a lightweight hiking shoe made for rugged exploration.


Kigerfly sets the pace, helping trail runners move quickly and confidently across technical terrain, while Kiger Hike translates the franchise’s nimble, connected feel into a hiking shoe built for backcountry trails, rugged exploration and everything in between.


The new footwear offerings join Picklejus,[ACG’s pinnacle expression of rugged mountain-running performance](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/acg-unveils-picklejus-big-mountain-trail-runner-with-goatek-traction-innovation) , as upcoming releases designed for the world’s wildest terrain and validated by leading trail-racing athletes from the[All Conditions Racing Department](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/nike-acg-all-conditions-racing-department) . Each is grounded in GOATEK, ACG’s proprietary traction platform.


Together, the silhouettes reflect ACG’s commitment to[serving outdoor athletes](https://about.nike.com/en/magazine/the-birth-of-acg-the-summit-that-launched-a-legacy) : creating[footwear](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/nike-acg-ultrafly-official-images) ,[apparel](https://about.nike.com/en/magazine/what-is-nike-radical-airflow) and accessories purpose-built to inspire confidence in all conditions.


**ACG Kigerfly**


ACG’s lightest trail-racing shoe is built to fly, combining responsive cushioning with a nimble, agile ride engineered for technical trails and sub-ultra distances — though All Conditions Racing Department athletes are[pushing the shoe even further](https://about.nike.com/en/magazine/videos/prototype-to-podium-riley-brady-on-western-states) .


Kigerfly pairs a durable ZoomX midsole and streamlined one-piece upper with a speed-tuned expression of GOATEK traction, featuring a 4-millimeter chevron-shaped lug pattern to help athletes accelerate, throw on the brakes and move confidently through technical terrain.


The silhouette is up to 21 percent lighter than[the Nike Kiger 10](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/nike-kiger-and-reactx-wildhorse-10-exclusive-images) in a men’s size 10, delivering a fast, race-ready feeling that helps runners fly through technical terrain with confidence.


“The first time I put on Kigerfly, I knew. It felt light, responsive and really natural underfoot," says[Racing Department athlete Jennifer Lichter](https://about.nike.com/en/magazine/videos/prototype-to-podium-jenn-lichter-on-how-she-won-western-states) , who wore Kigerfly while[setting a course record at Western States](https://www.instagram.com/p/DaHmhvQlXK7) . “On technical terrain, I don’t want to think about my shoes. I want to trust my feet, react to the trail and just run. Kigerfly lets me do that.”


Kigerfly has already proven its potential long before launch. All Conditions Racing Department athletes helped shape and validate every aspect of the final design over more than 22,000 miles of wear testing, taking more than 10 podium finishes.


“We’ve seen our athletes podium across races, conditions and distances around the world, and the feedback has been remarkably consistent,” says Andrew Bumbalough, Expert Product Line Manager, ACG Footwear. “Kigerfly is incredibly lightweight, nimble, connected to the trail and simply fun to run in. That feeling of confidence and connection isn’t just for elites, and I can’t wait for more trail runners to experience it.”


**ACG Kiger Hike**


ACG Kiger Hike is a technical hiking shoe built for closer connection to the terrain, channeling the nimble feel of Kigerfly into a lightweight silhouette. Created for rugged exploration,[ACG’s second hiking shoe](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/acg-debuts-the-zegama-hike-performance-hiking-boot-for-all-day-comfort-and-protection) since[the brand’s reintroduction](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/nike-reintroduces-acg-all-conditions-gear) delivers the lightweight comfort, traction and confidence to explore freely across changing conditions and terrain — whether chasing a new view, taking the trail less traveled or fastpacking into camp.


Kiger Hike’s low profile, 4-millimeter heel-to-toe offset and wider forefoot create a nimble yet stable platform. A Cushlon 3.0 midsole provides soft and responsive cushioning, while a full-coverage GOATEK outsole delivers traction, protection and durability, no matter the conditions. Additionally, a mesh upper with internal cabling and a distinctly ACG textured print balances lightweight breathability with structured security for the adventure ahead.


“One of my favorite things about hiking is that where you’re going is only part of the experience,” says Bumbalough. “The terrain changes, the trail surprises you, and sometimes the day takes you somewhere you didn’t expect. We wanted Kiger Hike to feel natural in those moments, keeping you engaged with what’s underfoot while giving you the confidence to keep exploring. It’s a shoe that makes people want to stay out there a little longer.”


**ACG Picklejus**


Taking its name from the near-mythical substance rooted in endurance-running culture, ACG Picklejus is purpose-built for long distances and rugged, big-mountain terrain.


Picklejus represents a complete mountain-running system, including ACG’s first co-molded, dual-density supercritical foam platform for trail running, a trusted GOATEK outsole and a trail-tuned Flyknit upper — all working in unison to balance uphill efficiency, downhill protection and resilience across varied terrain.


Developed through athlete insight, biomechanical research, robust[Nike Sport Research Lab testing](https://about.nike.com/en/magazine/nike-innovation-farm-team) and real-world mountain validation, Picklejus is designed to help athletes move farther, faster and with greater confidence through the most rugged and demanding terrain.


“When I’m deep in the mountains, I want to know I can trust what’s on my feet,” says[Racing Department athlete Yao Miao,](https://about.nike.com/en/magazine/trail-runner-yao-miao-is-running-down-new-goals-with-acg) who[podiumed in Picklejus](https://www.instagram.com/p/DcmcGzbCpMK) this past summer in Chamonix. “Picklejus gives me the confidence to keep pushing through technical terrain, especially when the miles start to add up. When your body is tired and you’re still trying to move fast, that confidence makes a huge difference.”


Kigerfly will be available at[nike.com](https://www.nike.com/) and select retailers in spring 2027, with Kiger Hike joining the lineup in the summer. Picklejus will launch globally in the fall.


***NIKE, Inc. is providing a sneak peek of Kigerfly and Kiger Hike as part of its World of Athletes* event, which offers an exclusive first look into some of the footwear and apparel that will debut in seasons to come.
